data.name: Google Calendar: Quick Add Event
data.description: Quickly create a calendar event from a natural language description like 'Meeting with Bob tomorrow at 3pm'.
data.instructions:
Quickly create a Google Calendar event from a natural language description.

Google interprets the description to set the event time, title, and details automatically.

**Inputs:**
- {description}: Natural language event description (e.g., "Meeting with Bob tomorrow at 3pm")

**Output:** {result} contains the created event details.
